figures.caption: Fig. 1. The overview of the proposed system in a NLOS road merging.
Fig. 2. Front and rear views of the ARI robot with its sensing, computation and actuation modules.
Fig. 3. Detection output of the dual camera infrastructure system showing vehicle tracking and projection of bounding boxes onto the road reference line.

Fig. 4. Experimental setup at the FMP. (a) Test site map showing the main road, the FMP road, the merging geometry and the defined ZoD. In this example, the V2X-equipped VW ID.4 (yellow) approaches along the main road while a test vehicle inside the FMP (blue) attempts to enter it. (b) Dualcamera infrastructure system used for long-range vehicle detection on the main road. (c) ARI robot executing the STOP gesture while moderating traffic at the FMP gate.
